[[File:18 May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament Ivan Gribov.jpg|thumb|right|260px|At the [[May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (18 May)]].]]
'''Ivan Gribov''' (DeckTech handle '''Executor96''') is a Star Wars CCG player who wrote a tournament report for DeckTech.

He played at the first MNSWCCG tournament at Twin City Comics. When he left Minnesota in May 2003, local players presented him, after the 18 May 2003 booster draft tournament, with an oversized [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]] objective they had signed.<ref name="pcf-1291-26390">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=26390#26390 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
